name: EU Equality and Non-Discrimination Directive
description: Policy framework aligned with EU Equal Treatment Directives (2000/43/EC, 2000/78/EC) and the EU Strategy for the Rights of Persons with Disabilities 2021-2030, addressing non-discrimination in employment and service access.
key_sections: Prohibition of Discrimination in Access to Services
key_requirements: Reference to EU Treaty provisions (Art. 19 TFEU) and/or ECHR
Coverage of all protected grounds: race, ethnicity, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation
Clear definitions of direct and indirect discrimination
Reasonable accommodation duty with undue burden threshold
Access to justice provisions (burden of proof reversal)
Designation of equality body or ombudsman
Data collection disaggregated by protected characteristics
Awareness and training obligations for public authorities
